root_cause: The only failing check is the PPA area gate: synthesized area 215237 exceeds the 190000-library-unit budget by ~13%. There is no data/control, protocol, or timing mismatch (trace_mismatches empty, failing_suites empty, return_code 0) — the design is functionally correct and the repair is an equivalence-preserving area reduction. The three named hotspots are redundant checkpoint/table storage (rename_unit's 16x32 checkpoint-map copies plus speculative/architectural map and free-list bookkeeping), oversized cache line/entry counts (icache, dcache), and wide pipeline/queue fields that are carried but never consumed (issue_queue, load_store_unit, reorder_buffer, top-level wiring).
repair_constraints: Binding interface contract: do NOT rename any port, module or file — rv32i5, icache, dcache, branch_predictor, if_stage, id_stage, rename_unit, physical_register_file, issue_queue, execute_alu, load_store_unit, reorder_buffer, commit_unit keep their exact names and port lists.
TB must remain PASS: every refactor must be behavior-equivalent — same retire events, halt/exit_code timing, handshake behavior and cache refill behavior.

Reduce area only through structural equivalence: de-duplicate checkpoint/table storage in rename_unit (share/compress ckpt_map instead of full per-slot redundancy), shrink cache line/entry counts in icache/dcache to the minimum the TB exercises, and delete wide fields that no consumer reads from queues/pipeline registers.

Preserve the already-landed fixes: rename_unit's FIFO->bitmap free-list refactor stays, and all writes into the 2D checkpoint array must stay constant-index (row-decoded) so yosys read_verilog does not hang.
Any narrowing of cache capacity or queue depth must keep the miss/refill contract (request held, addr constant, no abort of in-flight transactions) and the IF response epoch guard intact.

Keep all debug outputs (dbg_retire_valid/pc/insn, dbg_bp_resolve/mispredict, dbg_ooo_issue/bypass, dbg_features, dbg_reg_data) driven and architecturally correct — do not 'save area' by removing observable debug behavior.
